US FDA Approves Lilly's Mounjaro for Cardiovascular Risk Reduction

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved Eli Lilly's drug Mounjaro (tirzepatide) for a new indication: to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events. This approval is specifically for individuals with type 2 diabetes who also have established cardiovascular disease. The drug, previously known for its use in managing type 2 diabetes and weight loss, will now be marketed for its cardiovascular benefits.
